macros.name: fibnum
macros.doc: In exact two expansion steps the macro expands to the Fibnoacci number F⟨index⟩ .

macros.name: fibnumPreCalc
macros.doc: The argument ⟨index⟩ is a TeX number and macro \fibnumPreCalc ensures that the Fibonacci numbers F0 up to F|⟨index⟩| that are not already known are calculated and stored in internal macros.
